findings.message: A Git failure before target observation returns expectedTargetCommit plus a synthetic tree digest as preState. Exact observed pre-state may not be invented; pre-observation failure must reject/fail closed without a RawIntegrationEffectResult.

Command evidence hard-codes executable=git, omits timedOut, and loses the attempted argument array when spawnGit throws. Persist the configured executable and a normalized record for every attempted command including args, signal, timeout, and bounded output digests.
